metric_definitions.brand_mention_rate: Binary response-level mention (target entity mentioned >= 1 time) / valid observations
metric_definitions.explicit_recommendation_rate: Target entity explicitly recommended in numbered list or direct endorsement / valid observations
metric_definitions.citation_rate: Target entity domain/URL cited in grounding metadata or citations / valid observations
metric_definitions.first_recommendation_position: 1-based ordinal position of first target entity recommendation in explicit numbered lists
metric_definitions.competitor_share_of_voice: Share of all brand mentions captured by target entity among all identified competitors
metric_definitions.source_domain_frequency: Frequency of distinct third-party domains cited across all search groundings
metric_definitions.response_variability: Jaccard similarity and rank variance across repeat observations (k=2)
metric_definitions.missing_failed_observations: Count and proportion of failed, timed-out, or unavailable observations
